howItWorksText: Our Provably Fair system uses several parameters to ensure complete transparency and fairness. Each round has both hidden and revealed states.
everyRoundUses: Every round uses these four elements:
serverKeyText: Random string generated by the server
crashPointText: The multiplier where the round crashes
provablyFairHashText: SHA-512 hash of the combined data
provablyFairHashFormula: Provably Fair Hash = SHA512(ServerKey + "." + CrashPoint + "." + RoundNumber)
beforeGameBegins: Before the game begins, players can see:
beforeGameBeginsFooter: The Server Key and Crash Point remain hidden to ensure fairness.
onceTheRoundEnds: Once the round completes, all parameters are revealed:
onceTheRoundEndsFooter: The Server Key and Crash Point remain hidden to ensure fairness.
cryptographicHash: A cryptographic hash that proves the round outcome was predetermined
multiplierWhereRoundEnded: The multiplier where the round ended
remainsTheSame: Remains the same, proving nothing changed
maximumWinText: The highest possible multiplier is 25,000x your bet. This is the absolute ceiling—even if the game continues beyond this point (theoretically), your payout caps at 25,000x.
maximumCashOutText: When playing with free bets, a minimum cash-out multiplier applies (typically 1.50x, but configurable). You cannot cash out below this threshold when using promotional free bets.
placingBetsStep1After: using the +/- buttons or preset values (2.00, 5.00, 10.00, Max)
placingBetsStep2After: per round using the left and right betting panels
placingBetsStep3After: (purple button) to confirm your wager for the next comet launch
placingBetsStep5Before: When the comet launches and the multiplier starts rising,
cashingOutStep1After: at any time during the match to secure your winnings
cashingOutStep3: If you place two bets, each has its own cash-out button
cashingOutStep4Before: If you fail to cash out before the comet explodes →
cashingOutStep5: After cashing out, wait until the round ends to bet again
